description: Frontend structure + layout: (a) fix the uneven ('gatagata') bracket layout so round columns and series cards align cleanly (requirement #1); (b) put each series' game-by-game detail (the G1/G2... list) behind a per-series show/hide TOGGLE that is COLLAPSED by default (requirement #2); (c) introduce client-side routing and show a finished (status==='final') series' game-by-game detail on a dedicated DETAIL PAGE (requirement #3). The toggle collapsing the inline game list is the primary driver that equalizes card heights, so #1 and #2 are implemented together.
steps: Add react-router-dom to the frontend: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm install react-router-dom -w @mlb/frontend (and @types if needed - v6 ships its own types). If the install fails due to no network access, STOP and instead implement a minimal in-repo history-based router (pushState + popstate + a tiny route-matching hook) with NO new dependency, and record which approach was used in findings. Either way use HISTORY (path-based) routing, NOT hash routing: CloudFront already rewrites 403/404 -> /index.html with responseHttpStatus 200 (infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts), so path-based deep links resolve after deploy.
Wrap the app in a Router in frontend/src/main.tsx (BrowserRouter if react-router-dom, else the in-repo router provider). Keep the existing single root render.

Refactor frontend/src/App.tsx so the current bracket page becomes a route component (e.g. '/' or '/season/:season') and add a detail route for a finished series (e.g. '/series/:seriesId' or '/season/:season/series/:seriesId'). The home page keeps BracketView + StandingsPanel + PredictionPanel; the detail page loads the bracket (reuse getBracket/api.ts, including the existing offline seed fallback), finds the series by id, and renders its full game-by-game detail (teams, per-game scores, winner, series result). The detail page must handle a not-found series id gracefully (friendly message + link back) and preserve the selected season (via route param or query).

Create a SeriesDetailPage component (frontend/src/components/SeriesDetailPage.tsx or a routes/ folder) that renders the finished series' game list in a clean, full-width layout with a back link to the bracket. Reuse team-name resolution and TeamBadge. This is where a finished series' detail now lives (per requirement #3).

In frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.tsx: (1) Replace the ALWAYS-inline <ol class=series-card__games> with a per-series collapsible toggle. Add a button (e.g. 'Show games' / 'Hide games', aria-expanded, controls the list via aria-controls) that reveals/hides the game <ol>; COLLAPSED by default so every card starts at a consistent compact height. (2) For a FINAL series, provide a link (react-router <Link> or the in-repo equivalent) to that series' detail page in addition to (or instead of) the inline toggle - the inline toggle is fine for quick peeking, the detail-page link satisfies #3. Keep the non-final predictable 'Predict winner' affordance behavior as-is for now (final=>no-predict UI lands in FEAT-005, but if trivial you may hide predict for final here and note it).

Fix the layout alignment in frontend/src/styles.css: with the game list collapsed by default, ensure (a) all series cards in a column have consistent spacing and the columns do not visually drift ('gatagata'); consider aligning cards to the top of each column (align-items/align-content), consistent min-heights or consistent internal spacing so headers/teams/meta line up across columns; (b) the toggle button and its revealed list do not break the grid alignment when expanded (expanding one card should not misalign other columns - the CSS grid rows already handle this, verify). Keep the existing 860px (2-col) and 560px (1-col mobile) responsive behavior working and the no-horizontal-overflow guarantee intact. Add styles for the new toggle button, the detail-page layout, and the back link.
Update frontend/src/components/BracketView.tsx as needed to pass routing context (e.g. the current season) so SeriesCard can build correct detail links. BracketView keeps using buildRoundColumns.

Update/extend Playwright e2e (frontend/e2e/home.spec.ts + prediction.spec.ts + fixtures.ts, add a new spec if cleaner): (1) assert the game-detail list is HIDDEN by default and appears after clicking the per-series toggle (and the toggle's aria-expanded flips); (2) assert that clicking a finished series' detail link NAVIGATES to the detail page URL and the game-by-game detail renders there, and that a back link returns to the bracket; (3) keep/extend the narrow-viewport no-horizontal-overflow assertion; (4) capture full-page screenshots of the bracket (collapsed, aligned) and the detail page to test-results/ for visual verification of the layout fix. Update fixtures to include a bracket with a FINAL series (e.g. the stubbed 2026 bracket, or drive a results-only 2024 season via the seed) so the detail-page and final paths are exercised deterministically.
Run frontend build + unit tests + e2e to confirm green. Review the captured screenshots to confirm columns/cards align cleanly (the 'gatagata' fix) and the mobile single-column still holds.
acceptance_criteria: The game-by-game detail list is collapsed by default on every series card and toggles open/closed via a per-series button with correct aria-expanded; a Playwright test asserts both states.

A finished (final) series exposes a link to a dedicated detail page; navigating to it (including as a deep link URL) renders that series' game-by-game detail, and a back link returns to the bracket. Path-based routing is used (compatible with the existing CloudFront /index.html rewrite).
The bracket round columns and series cards align cleanly (no 'gatagata' drift) with the game lists collapsed by default; verified by full-page Playwright screenshots saved under test-results/.
The narrow mobile viewport (375px) still shows a single column and the document does not scroll horizontally (existing e2e assertion still passes).
PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build and npm test -w @mlb/frontend and npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend all pass.
findings:
DONE and green. Build (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra), `npm test` (all workspaces: shared 14, backend 57, frontend 20, infra 6), `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` (14 Playwright tests), and `npm run synth` all pass. FEAT-004 (i18n) and FEAT-005 (accuracy UI + final=>no-predict UI + specs/README) MUST build on these exact facts:

ROUTING APPROACH: react-router-dom was installed successfully (network available). PINNED to v6 (^6.30.6) deliberately for React 18 compat (npm's default resolved v7 which targets React 19; downgraded with `npm install react-router-dom@^6.28.0 -w @mlb/frontend`). package.json + root package-lock.json updated. HISTORY/path-based routing via <BrowserRouter> (NOT hash) - compatible with the existing CloudFront 403/404->/index.html rewrite; no infra change needed. `vite preview` (the e2e webServer) serves the SPA fallback for deep links, so direct deep-link navigation works in e2e too.

ROUTE TABLE (frontend/src/App.tsx is now just the <Routes> table; the old single-page body moved to frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx):
- `/`                                 -> <Navigate replace> to `/season/{DEFAULT_SEASON}` (DEFAULT_SEASON = CURRENT_YEAR = 2026).
- `/season/:season`                   -> HomePage (bracket + standings + prediction panel). Season is read from the URL param.
- `/season/:season/series/:seriesId`  -> SeriesDetailPage (frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.tsx).
- `*`                                 -> <Navigate replace> to the default season.
- main.tsx now wraps <App/> in <BrowserRouter>.

DETAIL-PAGE URL SHAPE: `/season/{season}/series/{encodeURIComponent(seriesId)}`. seriesId is the Series.id (e.g. `2024-ws-worldseries-119-147`). The season is preserved in the path (route param, parsed via frontend/src/seasonRoute.ts `parseSeasonParam`, which falls back to DEFAULT_SEASON for a missing/unknown/non-selectable value). SeriesDetailPage re-fetches via getBracket(season) (reusing api.ts offline seed fallback), finds the series by id, and renders teams/per-game scores/winner/series-result + a back link `Link to={/season/{season}}`. Unknown series id -> a friendly 'Series not found' section (role region aria-label 'Series not found') with a return link. The back link text is 'Back to the {season} bracket' (class .detail__back).

TOGGLE MARKUP/ARIA (frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.tsx) - FEAT-004 localizes these strings, FEAT-005 can build on the structure:
- The inline game <ol class="series-card__games"> is NO LONGER always rendered. It is wrapped in <div class="series-card__games-wrap"> with a toggle <button class="series-card__games-toggle" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={gamesListId}>. COLLAPSED BY DEFAULT (useState(false)); the <ol id={gamesListId} hidden={!open}> uses the HTML `hidden` attribute (CSS `.series-card__games[hidden]{display:none}`). Button label toggles between 'Show games' (collapsed) and 'Hide games' (expanded).
- gamesListId is `games-{useId().replace(/:/g,'')}` - colons stripped because React useId() returns ':rN:' which is INVALID in CSS id selectors / Playwright `#id` locators. Keep this when localizing.
- The toggle only renders when series.games.length > 0.

SERIESCARD BEHAVIOR CHANGES (note for FEAT-005): SeriesCard now takes a required `season: number` prop (BracketView forwards it; BracketView gained a `season` prop too, passed from HomePage). For a FINAL series it renders a <Link class="series-card__detail-link" to={detail url}> ('View series detail') INSTEAD OF the predict button. The 'Predict winner' button now renders ONLY when `onSelect && predictable && !isFinal` - i.e. I ALREADY HIDE predict for final series here (requirement #4's UI side partially lands here; the backend already gates final=>results in FEAT-002). The old always-rendered 'View details' button (for non-predictable seasons) was REMOVED; results-only seasons are all-final so they get the detail-page link instead. FEAT-005 should layer the fuller final=>no-predict messaging/accuracy UI on top of this; the prediction panel still shows for predictable seasons when a non-final series is selected.

LAYOUT FIX (frontend/src/styles.css): root cause of 'gatagata' was the always-inline game <ol> making cards wildly different heights; collapsing it by default equalizes them. Added: .bracket__column{min-width:0}; .series-card uses justify-content:flex-start and the single trailing action (.series-card__games-wrap / .series-card__detail-link / .series-card__predict) gets margin-top:auto so headers/teams/meta line up across cards & columns. .bracket__grid keeps align-items:start (top-aligned columns) and the existing repeat(N,1fr). The 860px (2-col) and 560px (1-col mobile) media queries and the no-horizontal-overflow guarantee are intact (375px overflow e2e still passes). New styles: .series-card__games-toggle, .series-card__detail-link, and the whole detail page (.detail, .detail__nav/__back/__header/__round/__title/__result/__teams/__team(--winner)/__team-name/__team-wins/__games-title/__games/__game/__game-num/__game-side(--winner)/__game-at, .detail--missing/.detail__hint).

SHARED HELPERS: frontend/src/seasonRoute.ts exports parseSeasonParam, hasSeriesStarted, hasStartedContent (the started-content logic moved out of App.tsx so HomePage reuses it).

E2E/FIXTURES: frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET now ALSO contains a FINAL ALCS (SAMPLE_2026_FINAL_SERIES_ID = '2026-al-championship-117-136', Houston 117 beat Seattle 136 4-2, 2 games with scores) alongside the existing in-progress WS, so the toggle + detail-page + final paths are exercised deterministically in the predictable 2026 season. New spec frontend/e2e/detail.spec.ts covers: collapsed-by-default + aria-expanded flip, navigate-to-detail-and-back, deep-link straight to a detail URL, and unknown-id not-found. home.spec.ts gained a 'collapsed by default on the 2024 bracket' test (+ bracket-2024-collapsed.png). Full-page screenshots in frontend/test-results/: bracket-2024(-collapsed).png, bracket-2025.png, series-detail.png, home-full/mobile.png (all gitignored). Visual review confirmed clean column/card alignment and the mobile single-column.

NOT DONE HERE (left as clean seams): no i18n/localization of any new string (FEAT-004), no accuracy UI control and no fuller final=>no-predict messaging/spec/README updates (FEAT-005).
